blocker.detail: The draft accepts status.state in ['complete_measurements_pending_review', 'failed']; it requires exactly eight owners only for the complete state, otherwise permits 1..8 owners. It then writes admit=True and invokes Popen --run for either state. A failed D10 with fewer than eight owners can therefore launch R044.
blocker.required_fix: Require status.state == 'complete_measurements_pending_review' unconditionally and require len(owners) == 8 unconditionally before writing D10_T16_OWNED_CLEANUP_READBACK.json, R044 admission, or Popen. Reissue a new immutable draft/hash and obtain a new independent review.
